name: WorkBuddy Switch Next — refined N cap v2
prompt: Precise refinement of the PROVIDED CAT WITH N CAP icon. Keep the entire cat, face, body, green/blue colors, ears, cheek pixels, curled tail, ivory background, crop, lighting and overall style unchanged. Refine ONLY the baseball cap's fit and perspective. Current problem: the visor sweeps too far down toward the viewer-left while the cap front faces a different direction, making the cap feel twisted and floating. Correct this into a coherent nearly front-facing cap that follows the cat head's gentle tilt. Move the cap's center subtly toward the cat's forehead center, make its dome slightly lower and more naturally seated between the ears, and give it one short smoothly curved visor projecting toward the viewer. The visor's curve, center seam, top button and front N panel must share the SAME perspective axis. Keep a small natural asymmetry, but no dramatic sideways cant, no long lopsided left flap. Shape the visor as a clean shallow curved oval band with a subtle visible underside. Improve the soft contact shadow along the forehead so the hat feels worn rather than pasted on. Keep both ears intact and visible, with clear plausible overlap where the cap meets their bases. Keep the same cobalt-blue matte fabric and a SINGLE white capital N on the front panel. N remains bold and clearly legible, centered on the crown and aligned to its slight curvature; refine its embroidery into a neat slightly flatter patch, no extra text. Do not redesign the hat style, change the character expression, enlarge the hat, or alter the composition. Preserve the original icon's friendly soft matte finish. No border, no transparent or black corners, no new objects. Deliver one finished icon.
integration: Cap angle and fit refinement; formal application icons have not been replaced.
